probes.rationale: Privacy disclosures and store declarations describe app/SDK behavior and affect distribution. A declaration-only PR with contradictory SDK evidence is within the skill even without code changes.

Block these answers/claim until the actual shipped SDK version, enabled configuration and data flows resolve the contradiction. Code unchanged does not validate changed disclosures. Obtain the SDK data inventory and purposes, off-device transmission conditions, retention/deletion and vendor handling; then draft accurate answers and policy text. Off-device processing alone does not determine every Play collection/sharing classification or exception: check the current official form definitions against the established facts before deciding exact answers.

The Windows direct channel does not acquire a Google Play Data safety form requirement.
P0 | X6 | affected final builds | to do | no source, binary, SDK configuration or controlled runtime/network evidence establishes which behavior ships. Bind inspection/configuration and data-flow evidence to the final reviewed revision/build/hash before closing P4. X1: confirmed target/channel reach is Android/Play and Windows/direct; check whether the changed declaration covers every offered Android surface. X4: no hardware qualification conclusion is needed for this textual consistency finding.
Physical-device plan: none required to identify the supplied contradiction; runtime data-flow validation remains to do and must record the actual test environment. Release blockers within scope: the contradictory declaration and unresolved shipped data flow. Limitations: supplied SDK note is provisional evidence, not observed traffic; exact disclosure classifications and current policy compliance remain unverified. No declarations, accounts or app behavior were changed.
